title: ANALOG FILTER SYNTHESIS/DESIGN
description: Approximation techniques for magnitude, phase, and delay specifications, transfer function realization sensitivity, passive LC filters, active RC filters, MOSFET-C filters, Gm-C filters, switched-capacitor filters, automatic tuning techniques for integrated filters. Filter noise. A design project is an integral part of the course
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: ( ELEN E3201 ) and ( ELEN E3801 ) or ELEN E3201 AND ELEN E3801 ; or equivalent.
